title: Food, Feed and Delivery Integrity Bill Public Deliberation Plan
proposal: Consolidated working Bill; not ready for introduction.

schedule.consultation_start: After exact primary-source crosswalk is published
schedule.consultation_end: Not less than 90 days after publication
schedule.urgent_exception: Written urgency reasons; immediate post-action consultation and review

participation.anti_retaliation: Confidential route and independent retaliation complaint

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Publish material meetings, funding, conflicts and methodology
integrity.anti_capture: Transparent moderation, duplicate detection and representative outreach

deliberation.method: Public hearings, State/local consultation and representative citizen panels

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Material accessibility, manipulation, source or evidence failure
